clientGuardIsNotEnforcement: clientGuard is the AccessGuard.require() value a page DECLARES. AccessGuard is browser JS over static hosting: it hides the body with CSS then redirects, so an unauthenticated HTTP request still receives the full page. Do not treat this field as access control. Real enforcement lives in firestore.rules.
